title: Joy without a perfect match
meaning: Waiting for perfectly matching wishes can obstruct shared enjoyment, although a good evening can hold different tastes.
text: Enjoyment together can easily become linked with feeling chosen: it is pleasant to do something you both like. The Lovers in the physical position of Svadhisthana describe choosing leisure together and taking an open interest in each other. The Lovers in energy have a more vulnerable role here, the wish for such a perfect match of desires that closeness is confirmed without a trace of doubt. The World in emotions brings a sense of completeness: the evening feels right when everything you value has a place.

Suppose you are choosing a film. One option appeals to one person, another to the other, and the search for a shared favourite takes longer than watching anything. **Closeness allows enjoyment to begin with different wishes.** You can choose one film today and another later without turning the decision into a test of affection. The evening's completeness can come from participation, conversation after the credits and time beside each other, as well as your opinions of the film.

The difficulty comes when disagreeing about a small pleasure feels like disagreeing about being together. You may start agreeing in advance to protect a lovely sense of unity, while your own wish loses its voice. The choice looks shared, yet feels less satisfying. Fullness returns where differences in taste remain an ordinary part of the life you share.
